_design_note: Recipe-faithful pilot. Two throwaway training seeds (1901/1902, deliberately NOT the five the real arms use, so this cannot contaminate them) and no holdout seeds at all, because nothing here is a result. Everything that costs resources is the real recipe: 100k replay, min_size 10000, E07, train_every 4, D4, n=3. It answers operational questions before twenty CPU-hours are committed: does the buffer actually reach 10000 inside E07's 100-round hold, at which round does the first gradient step happen, are loss / q_mean / gradient norm finite and bounded, does the validation trend rise while distinct_cells and bomb_rate stay off the floor, and what are the real RSS, disk and end-to-end throughput per seed. EXPLORATION SCHEDULE: E09, counted in environment steps rather than rounds. The pilot (runs/m4_pilot_20260827) measured why: at epsilon 1.00 a loot-crate round lasts 9.8 steps because random play kills itself at once, and 210 steps once the agent survives. Under E07's 100-round hold the buffer therefore held 982 of the 10,000 transitions min_size requires, and the first gradient step did not land until round 826 -- with epsilon already annealed to 0.11, which is precisely the cold start E07 existed to provide. E09 holds epsilon at 1.00 for 10,000 steps, exactly min_size, so the first gradient step sees a full buffer at full exploration, then anneals over 200,000 steps.

_predeclared_design_numbers.checks: 1) round_end learner_step.replay_size reaches 10000, and at what round; 2) the first round whose gradient_steps_this_round exceeds 0; 3) loss, q_mean, q_max, last_gradient_l2_norm all finite, and the gradient norm not pinned at the clip of 10; 4) validation score rises from the first to the last evaluated checkpoint; 5) distinct_cells > 20 and bomb_rate > 0.01 at the last checkpoint -- not the standing-still policy the smoke measured; 6) measured wall clock per training seed, peak RSS, and run directory size before compression.
_predeclared_design_numbers.purpose: Operational validation only. NO scientific claim may be quoted from this run.
_predeclared_design_numbers.stop_condition: If check 1 or 2 shows the first gradient landing after E07's anneal has begun, min_size or the schedule is wrong and the five-seed arms must not start.
